tickets.text: I can no longer reach services at the new Yuma site from the existing network. The local Yuma PC still appears connected to its local gateway, but remote access is not working.

Remote reachability to the new YUMAng site is down. The yumang backbone interface is physically up, but the IS-IS adjacency to snvang is not established and remote IS-IS routes are missing from yumang.
The new site seems offline from Atlanta. I can’t reach the Yuma host.
It looks like the physical link to the new Yuma router may be down because the site is unreachable from the rest of the network.
